node.title: Monodromy route stage 0: realize general aperiodic alignment as sheaf monodromy
node.statement: Express the aperiodic alignment count (general pairs, in-band agreements) as the trace function of an explicit sheaf family, so that big-monodromy + subgroup classification (the BETA_2 machinery, worked for the slack-line instance) applies. The enumeration = the subgroup classification (Kantor/ADW-style), complete by group theory.
node.notes: the unmapped step: BETA_2's sheaf covers ONE instance; the general realization is open
